name: BACH_0194
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged Tier 3 for out-of-distribution quality, foundation-model disagreement, and mostly Benign neighbors.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 91%, Benign 7%, Invasive 2% [F1] | Strong InSitu score, low invasion |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% coverage | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged); 100th-percentile OOD [F6] | Suspect input; atypical of training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu (20%), 3/5 Benign [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.32, contrib -0.80) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 6, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (+1.53, contrib -0.76) favors InSitu [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low (-0.23, contrib +0.70); 0/20 spot-check, unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 3, 5, 9) · context · 92% tumor fraction [F7], 4058/mm² density [F8], 51 µm² size [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009–0.006); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Small-nucleated proliferation is Benign (like 84%-similar BACH_0330), separated mainly by unreliable necrosis and normal_lobules.
- Out-of-distribution quality caused model disagreement or obscured focal stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 9, 11**: Confirm duct-confined atypia versus benign hyperplasia, especially highest-risk region 9 (risk 3%).
2. **Regions 5, 9**: Verify dense, small nuclei (51 µm²); check regions 9, 10, 11 for necrosis.
3. **Region 3**: Inspect stroma (31 connective, 36 neoplastic; 0% benign epithelium [F10]); consider recut, deeper levels, ER.
